title: Visible working sessions for Ask
purpose: Makes each request to Arcadia Ask a visible working session that keeps the original text, links and files, shows how it was routed, and lets the operator correct it before anything is committed.
serves: Its milestone: every Ask becomes a visible, correctable session that commits only operator-approved changes.
done_when: Submitting a request opens a session where the reading can be corrected, Ask rules can be managed, and a Living Songbook request is handled from start to finish.
reading_note: Superseded under Decision 0039: unstarted work moved behind the Agent Ask execution queue Plan. Its open Actions are preserved, not rejected.

actions.title: Make special routing visible and checkable
actions.why: When a message is sent to a special destination through a prefix, the operator can see exactly why it went there.
actions.done_when: A message starting with an exact rule prefix shows which rule matched and where it went, while ordinary words or links containing that prefix do not trigger it.

actions.title: Keep text, links and attachments together as one capture
actions.why: Nothing a person sends is lost or split up, and each derived result traces back to the original input.
actions.done_when: Text, links and attachments sent together form one capture that keeps the original text, each link as written, and a receipt for each file.

actions.title: Turn the capture receipt into a guided session
actions.why: The operator can see and correct Arcadia's reading of a request before anything is created.
actions.done_when: After submitting, the operator sees the reading with missing information marked unknown, a rule card with Continue, Use normal Ask and Edit rule, and no consequential write before an approved preview.

actions.title: Manage Ask rules from the same screen
actions.why: Changing a routing rule is safer when it can be previewed and tested against examples before it goes live.
actions.done_when: The rule view shows a rule's prefix, destination, status and recent matches, and changes are previewed and tested before they apply, with earlier versions kept.

actions.title: Prove the whole Ask experience with Living Songbook
actions.why: A real music-practice request, from a shared link to a practice log, shows the flow works on real records and not only on examples.
actions.done_when: Songbook commands resolve to the right read or proposed write, and a shared song link or a practice note with audio each produce a proposed record that keeps the original.
